summary: Kerb beside a private garden lot; homes 24 m or more across the road.

drivers.seclusion: South side is a private garden with hedge; dwellings across the road 24-28 m away, more homes close at the ends.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed road with a few cars parked on it; room to pull in at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Residential road, light traffic, one or two cars passing.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along this road but no clear parking convention.

flags: Mean slope about 3.5%, steep at the north end
sun_shade: Mostly open to the sun; palms and trees on the garden side give some afternoon shade.
cannot_judge: Whether the garden lot has a house on it

best_section.where: Harts Road south kerb, beside the big garden lot midway along
